_comment: The cycle rule, expressed once for two implementations. tests/unit/test_cc_value_rules_single_home.py executes these against hierarchy.can_place_under; frontend/unit/ccValuePaste.test.ts executes the SAME file against canPasteInto. Neither language may own a copy of the table: a case added on one side and not the other is the exact drift this exists to prevent. Adding a case means editing THIS file only.

cases.name: a deep node onto its own ancestor is allowed
cases.why: The reported case. History.AncientHistory.India under History yields History.India, a SIBLING of AncientHistory. Refusing this is what made the move read as a no-op.

cases.name: a deep node onto the top level is allowed
into its own direct child is refused
into its own deep descendant is refused
cases.why: The guard must hold at depth, not just for a two-level tree.

cases.name: a shared prefix that is not a path segment is allowed
cases.why: TestNodeOther merely starts with the same characters; it is a sibling, not a child. A bare startsWith(cut) with no separator would wrongly refuse this.

cases.name: a shared prefix one level deeper is allowed
cases.why: Historyics is not History. The separator, not the characters, is what makes a node an ancestor.
